description: Get one entry of the DiscoverIA registry by id: claim, claimant, current status with its rule, dated status history with sources, verifiers, links, statement fidelity, events, related frontiers and the plain-language summary. A status says where the evaluation stands, not whether the result is true.

id.description: Entry id (slug), e.g. 'gauss-sphere-packing-dim8', as returned by search_announcements.

lang.description: Language of titles, labels and texts: 'fr' (French) or 'en' (English). Default 'en'. Use the user's language.

name: get_announcement
title: Get one registry entry
